selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Use a thin transport listener that invokes one transactional application-service boundary for event receipt, business state, and resulting outbox when a second generic inbox relay would add latency and no independent recovery value.

selections.heading: Testing Posture
selections.text: For brownfield service database changes, use an ordered Flyway baseline plus additive migrations and prove existing-data upgrade, backfill, restart, and restore or forward-repair behavior; destructive reset is not acceptance evidence.
